scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @quiz/server" "npm run dev -w @quiz/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @quiz/web && npm run build -w @quiz/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/e2e
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser -w @quiz/web
